title: mentha pulegium subsp. gibraltarica
intro: Mentha pulegium subsp. gibraltarica, commonly known as Gibraltar pennyroyal, is a subspecies of the mint plant. It is native to the Iberian Peninsula and has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to possess anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of relieving digestive issues, reducing fever, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Gibraltar pennyroyal include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used to treat conditions such as headaches, nausea, and respiratory issues.
